import difflib
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
changes = {
    'axum/src/routing/path_router.rs': [
        ('pub(super) struct PathRouter<S = (), B = Body> {', 'pub(super) struct PathRouter<S = (), B = Body, const IS_FALLBACK: bool = false> {'),
        ('impl<S, B> PathRouter<S, B>', 'impl<S, B, const IS_FALLBACK: bool> PathRouter<S, B, IS_FALLBACK>'),
        ('other: PathRouter<S, B>', 'other: PathRouter<S, B, IS_FALLBACK>'),
        ('router: PathRouter<S, B>', 'router: PathRouter<S, B, IS_FALLBACK>'),
        ('-> PathRouter<S, NewReqBody>', '-> PathRouter<S, NewReqBody, IS_FALLBACK>'),
        ('-> PathRouter<S2, B>', '-> PathRouter<S2, B, IS_FALLBACK>'),
        ('''                crate::extract::matched_path::set_matched_path_for_request(
                    id,
                    &self.node.route_id_to_path,
                    req.extensions_mut(),
                );''', '''                if !IS_FALLBACK {
                    crate::extract::matched_path::set_matched_path_for_request(
                        id,
                        &self.node.route_id_to_path,
                        req.extensions_mut(),
                    );
                }'''),
        ('impl<B, S> Default for PathRouter<S, B>', 'impl<B, S, const IS_FALLBACK: bool> Default for PathRouter<S, B, IS_FALLBACK>'),
        ('impl<S, B> fmt::Debug for PathRouter<S, B>', 'impl<S, B, const IS_FALLBACK: bool> fmt::Debug for PathRouter<S, B, IS_FALLBACK>'),
        ('impl<S, B> Clone for PathRouter<S, B>', 'impl<S, B, const IS_FALLBACK: bool> Clone for PathRouter<S, B, IS_FALLBACK>'),
    ],
    'axum/src/routing/mod.rs': [
        ('fallback_router: PathRouter<S, B>,', 'fallback_router: PathRouter<S, B, true>,'),
        ('struct SuperFallback<S, B>(SyncWrapper<PathRouter<S, B>>);', 'struct SuperFallback<S, B>(SyncWrapper<PathRouter<S, B, true>>);'),
    ],
    'axum/src/docs/routing/fallback.md': [
        ("fallback is not called.\n", "fallback is not called.\n\nFallbacks don't provide a [`MatchedPath`](crate::extract::MatchedPath) since\nthey don't match a specific route.\n"),
    ],
}
for filename, replacements in changes.items():
    path = Path(filename)
    old = path.read_text()
    new = old
    for before, after in replacements:
        assert new.count(before) == 1, (filename, before, new.count(before))
        new = new.replace(before, after)
    subprocess.run(['patch', '-p0'], input=''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old.splitlines(True), new.splitlines(True), fromfile=filename, tofile=filename)), text=True, check=True)
